notes.body:
Purpose

Turns a basket into a confirmed order: stock is held, payment authorized, and one OrderPlaced event published for fulfilment.

How it works

The storefront calls the gateway (step 1), which creates the order in orders-svc (step 2). Then the order is checked and charged (steps 3–6).

Failure behaviour

FailureBehaviourStep
The customer is unknownThe order is refused, nothing is heldstep 4
Payment is declinedThe order stays, status payment_failedstep 6

Decisions

  • Reservations expire after 15 min, agreed with @{Dana Levi} on Oct 20.
  • The 201 returns the reservation id so payments can release the hold.

Open questions

  • Should a partial order be allowed for the optional warehouse? See step 5.
